'''Selonia''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. It was one of the [[Five Brothers/Legends|Five Brothers]], and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] race.

==Description==
Selonia was an industrial world, comprising many small islands surrounded by a global [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. However, to circumvent this obstacle, the Selonians dug an elaborate network of tunnels under the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surface, thus facilitating contact among their peoples. The planet's oceans were rumored to be the habitat of [[sea monster]]s, since it was said that only Selonia's oceans were large enough to accommodate these creatures.

[[File:Selonian_city-EotESoF.png|thumb|left|250px|A Selonian city]]
Selonian "dens" and tunnels ran through much of the planet's crust and mantle, while [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] operated above. Most of the vessels produced over Selonia were constructed for use within the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and, since Selonians generally had little interest in exploring further, were not fitted with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].

One of the most striking features of the planet was a volcanic mountain range known as the [[Cloudland Peaks]], said to rise so high that their tops were obscured.

Selonia was close enough to the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that it was easily recognizable by most [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] among the many [[Star/Legends|stars]] of the nighttime sky.<ref name="ST">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>

The [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived in hives created around a fertile female.

==History==
It was believed that the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] moved the planet into [[Corell/Legends|Corell's]] orbit, along with four other planets, facilitated by [[planetary repulsor]]s and [[Centerpoint Station]]. It is unknown whether Selonians were indigenous to the planet, or whether they were transplanted there by the Celestials. It is known that the planet was annexed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in [[30,000 BBY]].

In [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]], Selonia joined with [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in a failed attempt to conquer [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Centuries later, during the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], the planet was taken over by the [[Overden]].

Selonia was the site of a victory for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="WS" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Pride of Selonia (Lancer-class)|''Pride of Selonia'']] was named after the world. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Selonia was [[Blockade of Corellia|blockaded]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. By around [[130 ABY]], the planet was orbited by the [[Selonian Shipyards]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although previous sources might state that the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] are native to the planet Selonia, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' indicates that they were actually transported to the planet by the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] thousands of years earlier.

According to ''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]'', the Cloudland Peaks are located in the northern part of the planet on five islands. However, the map in ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' would suggest they are located on a single island.
